svg.title: Right Haar invariance sends 1BρcJ(a) da under a 7→expG(a)V to Haar restricted to expG(Bρ)V . The finite product on active links has density Q i cJ(ai), with inactive links fixed. The tree-gauge splitting into active and exterior link coordinates is measure preserving. Fubini permits active integration first, then exterior integration, after insertion of the bounded local ingredients. The powers of c and the Jacobian logarithms come from this product density. Regrouping then produces the quadratic Gaussian density and the explicit vertex factors; the grafted-signal and Gaussian- exponent constructions supply the selector implication and that decomposition. Sector selectors
